title: Jayden Maiava and Sam Huard Were Both Out At USC Practice: The Season Is Already Here - NewsBreak
text:
By Daniel Worbowski ,
1 days ago trophy logo on gradient background — Created by the Sports On Tap desk | Source : Sports On Tap (team logos property of their respective owners) USC Trojans were out there, grinding on Howard Jones Field in Los Angeles this Tuesday, August 18, 2026. You could feel that early season energy radiating from the field as The Sporting Tribune’s Dakota Gray was on hand to snap some killer pics. What we saw was a squad getting down to business, laying the groundwork for what’s coming next. No easing into it, full throttle preparation.
Quarterbacks Getting To Work, Right Now You wanna talk about signal callers? USC’s quarterbacks were right in the thick of the action. Jayden Maiava, number 14, was out there taking snaps like it was game day. He’s locking in already, making sure every handoff, every read, is dialed. And then you had Sam Huard, number 7, warming up. Getting that arm loose, getting ready to sling it. It’s awesome to see both those guys putting in the work, getting those crucial reps as the calendar inches closer to kickoff. This isn’t a casual jog around, this is focused, intentional work, and it shows.
Offensive Playmakers Are Already Hungry Man, those skill players were making things happen! Wide receiver Ethan “Boobie” Feaster, number 1, was out there snagging passes, making tough catches look smooth as silk. You gotta love that kind of hands work this early. Running back Waymond Jordan, number 2, was also catching balls, proving he’s a threat in the passing game, not only on the ground. King Miller, number 8, got in on the receiving action too, showing off his hands. And let’s not forget Kayden Dixon-Wyatt, number 17, who was fully participating, putting in the effort across the board. Plus, Luc Weaver, number 80, was running through those receiving drills, getting his timing down and making sure he’s sharp. These guys are pushing each other, making each other better, and it’s plain to see.
Grit On Defense and Building That Team Vibe It wasn’t an offensive show, no way. The defense was getting after it too. Linebacker Ryan O’Connell, number 41, was laying it all out there, taking hits during drills. That’s the kind of toughness you want to see from your defenders! Cornerback Prophet Brown, number 16, was participating in drills, locking in on his coverage. Running back Deshonne Redeaux, number 6, also got after it in drills. And you know what else really stood out? The entire USC football team gathered for a huddle. That’s a sign of a team coming together, building that crucial chemistry. Every player, every coach, all focused on the same goal. You can practically feel the collective drive they have right now.
Every single rep, every single drill, every moment on that Howard Jones Field right now is about getting these Trojans absolutely ready for whatever the season throws at them. The grind is real, and it’s happening. With the season fast approaching, you know these guys are pushing to be their absolute best. We’ll be watching closely to see what happens when they hit the field next, and what they bring to the table. This is the beginning!
